name: Delaware

retake.retakeFee: Retest fee applies; see DMV fee schedule

gdl.nightCurfew: No unsupervised driving 10 p.m.-6 a.m. during the restricted period (with exceptions)
gdl.passengerLimits: During the first 6 months of Level 1, no more than 1 passenger (household/immediate family exceptions)

requiredDocuments: Proof of identity and date of birth (e.g. birth certificate or U.S. passport)
Two documents proving Delaware residency (for REAL ID)
Under 18: driver education certificate and parent/guardian signature
process.realIdNotes: A Delaware REAL ID (Gold Star) requires proof of identity/date of birth, proof of Social Security Number, and two documents proving Delaware residency. A standard non-REAL ID credential is also available.
process.permitFee: Included in the Class D license fee
process.licenseFee: $50 for an 8-year Class D license (effective October 10, 2025)
process.visionStandard: 20/40 with or without corrective lenses (verify current DMV standard)

facts.pointSuspensionThreshold: Accumulating 14 or more points within 2 years can lead to license suspension
facts.moveOverRule: Move over a lane, or slow down if you cannot change lanes safely, for stopped emergency and authorized vehicles displaying flashing lights
facts.interstateMaxSpeed: 65 mph on interstate highways where posted
facts.schoolZoneSpeed: 20 mph in a school zone during posted school hours

verifyNote: Official Delaware DMV sources confirm the 30-question exam with 24 correct required, age 16 minimum, GDL rules, current $50 Class D fee, and the 14-calculated-point mandatory suspension. The direct June 2024 manual PDF is recorded. The numeric vision standard was not confirmed in the official manual, so it remains separately qualified.
